title: Landing page
description: Creates a Link Loom landing page (Astro, static) that looks and behaves like the Mi Retail landing: glass header with dropdowns, language switch, ink footer, sticky call to action, every page in English and Spanish under /en/ and /es/, SEO and structured data, the home hero and closing call to action, contact and legal pages, brand files and the image pipeline. Layers add the blog, full-text search and the development-only blog editor. Change any section later with `add section --page home --kind <kind> --id <id> --replace --yes`, and any text with `add copy --replace --yes`.

name.description: Product name people see: header, titles, share images (e.g. "Acme")

slug.description: Machine name: folder and package name. Defaults to the name in kebab-case

domain.description: The site's domain without https:// (e.g. "acme.com"): canonical URLs, sitemap and structured data. Defaults to <slug>.com

description.description: One or two sentences about the product, in English: meta description, home deck and share image

descriptionEs.description: The same description written natively in Spanish (neutral, with "tú"). Falls back to the English one with a warning

slogan.description: Short tagline in English: page titles, footer and the home hero title. Defaults to the first sentence of the description

heroTitle.description: The home's h1 in English; *asterisks* mark the highlighted words (e.g. "The operations center your *whole business* runs on."). Defaults to the slogan, its last word highlighted

heroTitleEs.description: The home's h1 in Spanish, with its *highlighted* words

legalName.description: Company name for the structured data and the footer rights (defaults to the name)

directory.description: Target folder, relative to the working directory (defaults to the slug); "." creates the site in the working folder itself, which must be empty

primaryColor.description: Brand colour: the mark, the generated logo, the browser's theme colour and share images

secondaryColor.description: Second brand colour, for brand moments

accentColor.description: Signature accent: the highlighted words of titles, focus rings, hover and current states

ctaColor.description: Fill of the main call-to-action pills (near black by default)

monoFont.description: Google Fonts family for labels and data

logo.description: Path to the logo for light backgrounds (SVG, or PNG of at least 512 px): the header. Without it a monogram and wordmark are generated

logoDark.description: Path to the logo for dark backgrounds: the footer (defaults to `logo`)

mark.description: Path to a square symbol for the favicons (defaults to a monogram)

signInUrl.description: The product's sign-in address: a "Sign in" link in the header. Empty: no link

signUpUrl.description: The product's sign-up address: every "Get started". Empty: they go to the contact page

salesEmail.description: Sales email: contact page and structured data (defaults to sales@<domain>)

supportEmail.description: Support email: contact page, legal pages and structured data (defaults to support@<domain>)

contactFormAction.description: Where the contact form posts (a form service or your backend). Empty: the contact page lists the emails only

parentName.description: The company behind the product, credited in the footer and the structured data. Empty: no credit

parentUrl.description: Address of the company behind the product

blog.description: Blog layer: posts in both languages, categories, listing, post page with related posts and article structured data

search.description: Search layer: ⌘K search over the whole site with Pagefind, and a search page

editor.description: Blog editor layer: write and edit posts in the browser under `npm run dev` (never in the build). Needs the blog

examples.name: Acme
examples.description: The operations center for your business.
examples.descriptionEs: El centro de operaciones de tu negocio.
